meta.name: azure-functions
meta.description: Expert patterns for Azure Functions development including isolated worker model, Durable Functions orchestration, cold start optimization, and production patterns. Covers .NET, Python, and Node.js programming models. Use when "azure function, azure functions, durable functions, azure serverless, function app, azure, serverless, functions, durable-functions, cloud" mentioned.
